name: @kickside/inbox-ui
title: KickSide Inbox
description: Inbox review surface web component for kickside/inbox.

wippy.description: Builds two web components (per-tag details live in the module registry, src/_index.yaml): the primary tag kickside-inbox (index.js) and the lightweight detail renderer kickside-inbox-notice (notice.js). kickside-inbox renders a Gmail-style master/detail inbox: Pending/Resolved/All filter tabs, an item list, and a detail pane whose body is filled by the item type's declared component tag — mounted with 'item-id', 'content', and 'data-meta' (JSON metadata) attributes — falling back to a native content-plus-fields body when the item type declares no component. Approve/reject/dismiss/delete actions post to /api/v1/inbox, and counts stay live via a subscription to the owner inbox component's public meta. It takes no props and emits no custom-element events itself; mounted item-type components report actions by dispatching an 'inbox-resolve' CustomEvent whose detail is {id, action}. kickside-inbox-notice is the built-in renderer for notice items: a plain HTMLElement that reads its 'content' and 'data-meta' attributes (data-meta JSON may carry a fields array of {label, value}) and renders content as Markdown through the shared wc-render-markdown renderer plus a label/value field table.
